ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a quadratic spectral gaussian grid type.
description: Quadratic spectral Gaussian horizontal grid (192 longitudes x 96 Gaussian latitudes = 18,432 cells) associated with triangular spectral truncation T63. Zonal spacing is uniform at 1.875 degrees; meridional Gaussian spacing varies between 1.84964 and 1.86526 degrees (~1.865 degrees).
